summary: Alternate Debug formatting of empty containers produced "[\n    ,\n]" instead of "[]". The fix guards both whitespace/separator writes with !self.is_empty() in ArrayVec, SliceVec, and TinyVec; it does not delegate to slice formatting as the imported record claims. The ArrayVec reversal below restores both original conditions. Blocked: no detecting upstream test exists at this commit. The fix changes no tests; ArrayVec_pretty_debug and TinyVec_pretty_debug only format three-element containers, while ArrayVec_formatting checks empty Debug output only in non-alternate mode. The imported case_empty and case_three_elements tests are absent. No tests were run.
